property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the GuidePreference (a Application or Document).

property.name: guidesInBack
property.shortdesc: If true, places guides behind all other objects on the spread.

property.name: guidesLocked
property.shortdesc: If true, guides cannot be moved, added, or deleted.

property.name: guidesSnapto
property.shortdesc: If true, an object within the specified range snaps to the nearest guide when the object is created, moved, or resized. For range information, see guide snapto zone.

property.name: rulerGuidesViewThreshold
property.shortdesc: The magnification (as a percentage) less than which ruler guides do not appear. (Range: 5 to 4000)

property.name: rulerGuidesColor
property.shortdesc: The color of the guide, specified either as an array of three doubles, each in the range 0 to 255 and representing R, G, and B values, or as a UI color. . Can return: Array of 3 Reals (0 - 255) or UIColors enumerator.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the GuidePreference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
